title: John on Patmos and the vision of the risen one
description: John is in exile on the island of Patmos for the sake of God's word. On the Lord's day he comes into the Spirit and hears a voice like a trumpet, telling him to write to the seven churches in Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea. He sees a figure resembling the Son of Man standing among seven golden lampstands, with seven stars in his right hand and a double-edged sword coming out of his mouth. John falls down as though dead, but Christ says: "Do not be afraid! I am the First and the Last, the Living One. I was dead, but see, I am alive forever and ever, and I hold the keys of death and Hades." He explains that the stars are the angels of the churches and the lampstands are the churches.
